center.note: Map centre only; not a claim about any structure.

levels.name: Surface
levels.note: Lead, South Dakota; Yates and Ross shaft surface complexes.

depth_m.note: Houses the Davis Campus (LZ, Majorana Demonstrator) accessed via the Yates Shaft, and the LBNF/DUNE far-detector caverns accessed via the Ross Shaft; plan view only.
depth_m.quote: The entire experiment will be located at the 4850 Level (1478 m) Davis Campus at the Sanford Lab Underground Research Facility (SURF).

levels.name: 4850 Level (1478 m)
levels.note: Plan view. The LBNF/DUNE detector caverns are drawn here (derived from published module coordinates, see their records); the cryostats rest on the 4910 level, about 60 ft below the 4850 floor, and the caverns are 28 m high, so the plan outline is the 4850 plan projection of a deeper void. Davis Campus point is surveyed; the Central Utility Cavern and the drifts are not drawn.

name: SURF — Sanford Underground Research Facility, Lead, South Dakota
notes: Central Utility Cavern (190 m x 19.3 m, between the two detector caverns per DUNE TDR Vol. III 5.2) is not drawn: no fetched source gives its offset along the cavern axis.
Conflict: detector caverns are 144.5 m long in the DUNE TDR (design, 2020) and 521.5 ft = 158.95 m on a December 2023 Fermilab slide; the drawn length is the latter (see geometry records).
Heise (arXiv:2603.06504) Table 4 prints its Latitude and Longitude column headings interchanged; the values carry hemisphere letters and are unambiguous.

schematics.note: Official schematic, slide 27; topology only (Ross Shaft, west and south drifts, two detector caverns flanking the Central Utility Cavern). Never drawn on the to-scale map.
schematics.title: LBNF/DUNE 4850 Level cavern and drift layout (3D CAD view labelled with cavern sizes; not to scale)

summary.plain: SURF’s surface campus in Lead, South Dakota (Yates and Ross shaft areas) and the 4850 Level 1478 m below, home to the Davis Campus (LZ, Majorana Demonstrator) and the two huge caverns excavated for the DUNE far detector.
summary.technical: Local map for facility:surf: OSM building footprints for the Yates and Ross head-frames and hoists, the Davis Campus cavern at its surveyed coordinate (SURF Physics Procedia Table 5), and the LBNF/DUNE north and south detector caverns on the 4850 Level, derived from the published FD1-FD4 module coordinates (Heise 2026, Table 4) and the as-excavated cavern size (521.5 ft x 65 ft). The Central Utility Cavern and access drifts are not drawn.
